---
title: "check-dependency-updates.yml"
---

Conduct automated dependency freshness audits
on a repository.
Mines upstream releases, tags, and changelogs
for pinned third-party GitHub Actions,
`renv.lock` packages, submodules, and tool versions
to surface high-value opportunities and to-dos
as tracked issues in the repository.

Follows the Morrison-Lab `/check-dependency-updates` skill rubric.
The agent scans repository dependency pins,
queries upstream GitHub APIs for latest releases and commits,
inspects release notes for bug fixes, security patches, and features,
verifies that issues do not duplicate existing open or closed issues,
and files actionable, evidence-backed update issues.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target-repo` | string | `${{ github.repository }}` | Target repository receiving the dependency audit. |
| `dry-run` | boolean | `false` | When true, writes findings to the step summary instead of opening issues. |
| `max-issues` | number | `5` | Maximum number of opportunity issues to open in a single run. |
| `labels` | string | `'enhancement'` | Comma-separated labels applied to created issues. |
| `model` | string | `''` | Claude model to use for the audit session (empty defers to default). |
| `use-ai-config` | boolean | `true` | Install the Morrison-Lab/ai-config plugin for the dependency-audit skill. |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | `45` | Job timeout in minutes. |

## Secrets

| Secret | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` | no | Claude Code OAuth token (Claude Max plan). |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | no | Direct Anthropic API key. |

## Permissions

Grant `contents: read` and `issues: write`.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check Dependency Updates

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 14 * * 1' # Weekly on Monday at 14:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: Run audit without filing issues (output to step summary)
        type: boolean
        default: false

jobs:
  audit:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-dependency-updates.yml@v3
    secrets:
      CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry-run || false }}
    #   max-issues: 5
    #   labels: 'enhancement'
    #   model: 'claude-sonnet-4-5'
    #   use-ai-config: true
    #   timeout-minutes: 45
```

See the
[`examples/`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/tree/main/examples)
directory for the full caller stub (`check-dependency-updates.yml`).
